content.title: Rita's celebrates first day of spring with free water ice, Philly pop-up event
content.text: Rita's Italian Ice is celebrating the first day of spring with free water ice at all of their locations as well as a pop-up event in Philadelphia. NBC Universal, Inc. Rita’s is celebrating the first day of spring with free water ice! With spring arriving, a sweet seasonal staple is here as well. On Friday, March 20, Rita’s Italian Ice & Frozen Custard is celebrating the first day of spring with free 6-ounce Italian Ice for customers at all of their locations nationwide. Take a look at the list of Rita’s locations in our area. All locations are open from 12 p.m. through 9 p.m. Philadelphia 1511 Spruce Street 2124 South Street 239 South Street 1001 North Delaware Avenue 2499 Aramingo Avenue, Suite H 2271 West Hunting Park Avenue 1923 East Hunting Park Avenue 100 East Rockland Street 5815 Wayne Avenue 7718 City Avenue 5744 North Mascher Street 5901 Rising Sun Avenue 6901 Stenton Avenue 8201 Stenton Avenue 499 Domino Lane 6200 Frankford Avenue, Suite A Delaware County 1550 Garrett Road, Upper Darby, Pennsylvania 5060 Township Line Road, Drexel Hill, Pennsylvania 445 MacDade Boulevard, Collingdale, Pennsylvania 500 West Chester Pike, Havertown, Pennsylvania 55 West Eagle Road, Havertown, Pennsylvania South Jersey 108 Haddon Avenue, Unit 1, Haddon Township, NJ 245 South Broad Street, Woodbury, NJ 877 Cooper Landing Road, Crossroads Plaza, Store 4, Cherry Hill, NJ 1811 Cinnaminson Avenue, Cinnaminson, NJ Rita’s is also celebrating spring in Philadelphia with a “Swing Into Spring” pop-up event at Schuylkill River Park on 300 South 25th Street from 3 p.m. through 5 p.m. on Friday, March 20. Local Breaking news and the stories that matter to your neighborhood. The event will include free samples of Rita’s Mango Italian Ice as well as a new mystery Italian Ice flavor. It's all part of a contest Rita’s will run from March 20 through March 29 in which customers will taste the mystery water ice and try to guess the flavor. Learn more about the contest and submit your guesses here. Rita’s was founded in 1984 in Bensalem, Pennsylvania, and has remained an iconic spot in the Philadelphia region for four decades.
